# Gabriel Moreno Ribeiro

> 18, from Salvador, Brazil, living in São Paulo. Co-founder of HIBEEX (back-office AI for small and medium businesses) and founder of Projeto Candela.

Website: https://gabrielmr.com
Email: me@gabrielmr.com
LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/gabriel-moreno-ribeiro
GitHub: https://github.com/gabriel-moreno-ribeiro
One-pager: https://gabrielmr.com/one-pager
Last updated: October 2026

## Summary

Gabriel Moreno Ribeiro is 18 and Brazilian. He grew up between Salvador, Bahia, and Missão Velha, a small town in Ceará where his grandfather has a garage; he started helping him fix cars at 6. He did his last year of high school in Fortaleza and moved to São Paulo in 2026 to build HIBEEX with his co-founder, Teodoro Trevisan. He is on a build year before university.

## Now: HIBEEX (January 2026 to present), co-founder

- Runs the back office of small and medium businesses (accounting, finance, legal) through the people who already look after them: the accountant, the finance BPO and the lawyer. Plugs into the systems accounting firms already use (Domínio, Conta Azul, Nibo, Omie), cleans the data and puts agents to work: reconciliation, collections, contracts.
- Before writing code, Gabriel and Teodoro talked to 96 people, from SMB owners to COOs at big tech. Sales turned out to be top-down, so today they work from inside client operations in Porto Alegre and São Paulo, running the back office as a service to learn the process before going back to the product.
- Traction: 3 accounting firms as design partners, 40+ SMB accounts running the agents, about R$ 3k MRR today and R$ 40k signed for January 2027 (contract with RP Métodos). At one client: an accounting service went from 8h to 2h and days to get paid from 63.9 to 9. 94% accuracy in automatic reconciliation; R$ 12,480 recovered for a single client.
- One of 6 startups in the Canastra Ventures AI Residency (12 weeks, 0.55% acceptance); Gabriel and Teodoro are the youngest founders to graduate from it. Also: European Innovation Academy (1 of 10 from 5,000+ applicants), Latitud Fellowship (top 20%), LALA Start, Claude for Startups, AWS for Startups.
- Team: Teodoro Trevisan (co-founder, from Porto Alegre, founded Voluntaria+) and Devansh Chopra (CTO, joining through Entrepreneur First).
- Gabriel is a co-founder, not a CEO. It is a small team.
- Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, Supabase, PostgreSQL, AWS.

## Before

- Repaired 121 laptops in Salvador to pay for school, shipped to 21 states, all by referral. At 11 he wrote a Python script that translates and dubs Hindi repair tutorials into Portuguese.
- In 2020, at 12, his father's clinic nearly closed. He built a chatbot with his mother's voice to answer the phone, an automation to collect what health plans owed, and a dashboard with the data and contracts.
- Projeto Candela (2022 to present), founder: free low-cost physics lab kits for public schools, with the Federal University of Bahia. Visited 60+ schools before having a budget, funded by a research scholarship and crowdfunding. 140 kits, 28 public schools in Bahia and Ceará, 3,392 students. Physics grades up 40% and failure rates from 30% to 10%. Presented at the International Institute of Physics and at Fundação Estudar's annual meeting.
- GSAT Education (November 2025 to May 2026): a test-prep platform he built from scratch.
- President of the Olympic Club at Colégio Militar de Salvador (August 2024 to May 2026): 17 initiatives, participation up 47%, national olympiad results up 62%.

## Research

- The Steady-State Hypothesis (Instituto Principia, Escola de Talentos, 2023 to 2026, advisor Prof. Juliano Alves Bonacin): a 150-page monograph on when the steady-state approximation in chemical kinetics holds and how much it misses, from ozone photolysis to ammonia synthesis, with simulations and data from the SABIO-RK database. PDF: https://gabrielmr.com/research/chemical-kinetics/paper.pdf
- Fintech savings RCT (Fundação Estudar research fellowship, 2025, mentored by Aaron Litvin, Ph.D., Harvard): randomized controlled trial with 208 public-school students; the treatment group saved 130% more.
- Projeto Candela paper: https://gabrielmr.com/research/projeto-candela/paper.pdf

- 28 olympiad medals across 39 science olympiads (math, physics, chemistry, biology, astronomy). 5 golds at Mathématiques sans Frontières (international). Gold at ONNEQ, 1st at OBAQ, gold at the Biotechnology Olympiad and ONC.
- SAT 1570/1600 (Reading and Writing 770, Math 800), above the 99th percentile. Score report: https://gabrielmr.com/files/sat-score-report.pdf

- Instituto Principia Escola de Talentos: 1 of 14 picked nationally.

- Insper: 1st place admission, Computer Engineering.
